name: Stagalbog Cave
summary: Marsh murlocs shelter in Stagalbog Cave, deep in the eastern Swamp of Sorrows.

sections.title: Den of the Marsh Tribe
sections.body: In the eastern Swamp of Sorrows, the Marsh murlocs shelter from the rain in Stagalbog Cave. They guard its winding chambers under their chief mystic, the Swamp Talker. Near the sunken mire of the Stagalbog, their gurgling calls cross the mossy banks and warn travelers away from their nesting grounds.

faq.answer: Stagalbog Cave lies in the Stagalbog, in the eastern Swamp of Sorrows. Marsh murlocs occupy the natural cavern.
The Marsh tribe rules the cave under the Swamp Talker. The murloc mystic oversees their rituals and defenses in its damp chambers.
Hostile marshlands surround the cave. For the Horde, the nearest friendly settlement is Stonard, to the west.
